pattern: (unable to lock database|error: failed to init transaction \(unable to lock database\)|/var/lib/pacman/db.lck: File exists)
remediation: pgrep pacman >/dev/null && echo 'Pacman is running' || sudo rm -f /var/lib/pacman/db.lck
explanation: Pacman lock file exists from a background or interrupted pacman command.

pattern: (invalid or corrupted package \(PGP signature\)|error: .* signature from .* is unknown trust|key .* could not be looked up remotely)
explanation: The local Arch Linux keyring is out of date and cannot verify package signatures.

pattern: error: failed to commit transaction \(conflicting files\):\s*(.*) exists in filesystem
explanation: An untracked file exists on the filesystem that collides with the package being installed.

pattern: modprobe: FATAL: Module (.*) not found in directory /lib/modules
remediation: echo 'Kernel was updated. A system reboot is required to load new modules.' && uname -r
explanation: Kernel modules for the currently running kernel were removed during a live kernel package upgrade.
